_comment: L3.f (pre-registered 2026-09-09, user decision): L3.e's trombone sizes the stretch against the BEELINE distance to the threshold, so a vectored flight whose intended path is far longer than the beeline is read as having a huge surplus (tromboneDelayS p50 391 s at offset 0) and is over-stretched (endpoint |xt| p95 10 km, 46 % of flights not reaching the threshold by T_cta at offset 0). L3.f changes only the estimator: surplus = remaining time minus the time the HOOK-FREE REFERENCE ROLLOUT's remaining path needs at V_e (the nominal-law hook already integrates such a parallel reference; reuse it), config axis trombone_surplus_reference in {beeline, reference-rollout}, default beeline so L3.e stays reproducible. Same four predict-only arms on L3_cta, barrier+speed-floor+trombone, soft, --truncate-at-threshold. GATES: L3.e's five, plus (6) tromboneDelayS p50 at offset 0 <= 30 s (the estimator no longer invents surplus) and (7) endpoint |xt| p95 at offset 0 <= 2x the L3.c hook arm's 1611 m. The decisive numbers: fully-flyable at +60 (L3.e 52.4 %, gate 88.4 %), the share of flights reaching the threshold at offset 0 (L3.e 54 %), and whether tromboneDelayS still rises exactly 30 s per 30 s of offset.
